title: Objectwise tensoring preserves sheafification-isomorphisms
statement:
In the situation of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf], let $a$ be sheafification of
$\mathcal A$-valued presheaves on $C$, left adjoint to the inclusion $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)\subseteq\mathrm{PSh}(C,\mathcal A)$,
and let $W$ be the class of morphisms $g$ of presheaves with $a(g)$ invertible. Equivalently, $g\in W$ if and only if
$\Hom(g,H)$ is bijective for every sheaf $H$.

1. If $g\in W$ and $F$ is a presheaf, then $F\otimes_pg\in W$ and $g\otimes_pF\in W$.
2. If $g\colon F\to F'$ and $h\colon G\to G'$ lie in $W$, then $g\otimes_ph\in W$.
3. For presheaves $F,G$, the morphism $F\otimes_pG\to aF\otimes_paG$ built from the units of
   $a$ lies in $W$; hence $a(F\otimes_pG)\to a(aF\otimes_paG)$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text:
The equivalence of the two descriptions of $W$: $\Hom(g,H)\cong\Hom(a(g),H)$ for sheaves $H$, so
by Yoneda in $\Sh(C,\mathcal A)$, $a(g)$ is invertible if and only if $\Hom(g,H)$ is bijective for
all sheaves $H$.

1. Let $H$ be a sheaf. By the adjunction of [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-presheaf],
   $\Hom(F\otimes_pg,H)\cong\Hom(g,[F,H])$ naturally. The presheaf $[F,H]$ is a sheaf by
   [det-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor-hom-sheaf], so this map is bijective, and $F\otimes_pg\in W$. The
   objectwise symmetry identifies $g\otimes_pF$ with $F\otimes_pg$, giving the second claim.

2. Write $g\otimes_ph=(F'\otimes_ph)\circ(g\otimes_pG)$. Both factors lie in $W$ by 1, and $W$
   is closed under composition.

3. The map is $\eta_F\otimes_p\eta_G$, with $\eta$ the unit of $a$, and $a(\eta_F)$, $a(\eta_G)$
   are isomorphisms; so 2 applies.
